messages:
alex_chan: Quick presales sync for NimbusCorp. They want commit sizing: steady 1k RPS, avg 60 tokens, spikes to 2.2k for ~10m. 95th latency target 350ms, CCPA + KMS required. Can we propose reserved + autoscale?
marie_devrel: Traffic shape clarified, thanks. Any long-tail batch jobs?
samir_infra: Yes occasional 300+ token backfills. Recommend baseline reserved 10 GPUs, burst pool 6 GPUs, and separate batch workers for long jobs.
jess_prod: To hit 95th 350ms, need prewarmed slots and prefix KV caching. Suggest admission control to protect interactive traffic.
olivia_secu: On security: we support customer-managed KMS, HSM rotation, per-request audit logs and deletion APIs. Will need DPA and DSR commitments in contract.
finance-bot: Pricing hint: baseline 10R + 6B + optional 24/7 prewarm add-on. I'll produce delta numbers if sales confirms term length.
alex_chan: Samir, can you drop an autoscale snippet we can include in the proposal?
samir_infra: Sure — short snippet: baseline:10, burst_max:6, preheat:120s, cooldown:180s, slo95_ms:350, fallback:quantized-variant. Also recommend 10% AZ headroom.
marie_devrel: I'll offer to run a 300-sample eval to compare quantized fallback quality (48h).
jess_prod: Add prefix cache warmup steps and a runbook cite. Route big backfills to batch pool to avoid tail impact.
olivia_secu: I'll draft security appendix (KMS options, audit retention, deletion SLA). Legal might require 48hr deletion clause.
alex_chan: Actions: 1) I'll send draft pricing with 10R+6B + AZ option. 2) Marie run eval. 3) Samir add autoscale + AZ notes. 4) Olivia draft sec appendix. Aim to present tomorrow.
finance-bot: Noted. I'll prepare cost lines once commit term confirmed.
alex_chan: Thanks — will follow up after eval results. :thumbsup:
